name: Sodium Valproate
summary: Sodium valproate is a widely used seizure medicine and mood stabilizer for several seizure types, acute mania in bipolar disorder and migraine prevention.
description: Sodium valproate is a form of valproic acid, widely used as a seizure medicine and mood stabilizer. It is approved for several seizure types, including generalized, focal and absence seizures, as well as for acute mania in bipolar disorder and to help prevent migraines. It works by raising levels of GABA (a calming chemical messenger) in the brain and by acting on sodium and T-type calcium channels in nerve cells. It can be taken by mouth or given through a vein (IV).
